Headings: The Chainbridge Hotel | A riverside retreat | Our Rooms | The Chainbridge Suite | Junior Suites | Riverside Double | Canalside Double | Family Room Homepage forms: 0 Visible homepage text: The Chainbridge Hotel | Riverside Hotel, Llangollen, North Wales Chainbridge Hotel Rooms Dining & Bar Gallery Contact Book Now Llangollen · North Wales The Chainbridge Hotel An historic riverside escape on the banks of the River Dee Reserve a Room Scroll Est. 1828 A riverside retreat The Chainbridge is an historic riverside hotel only one mile outside the famous North Welsh market town of Llangollen. With stunning views of the fast-flowing River Dee, the two hundred-year-old chain bridge & Llangollen's popular steam railway, it is hard to think of a more beautiful setting in which to relax, explore & unwind. The hotel has 33 rooms, many of which enjoy balconies overlooking the stunning river, and offers breakfast, lunch & dinner, as well as a public bar which is open throughout the day. Open to residents and non-residents alike, The Chainbridge is an independent, family-run hotel which prides itself on providing you with a warm welcome in stunning surroundings. 33 Unique rooms Accommodation Our Rooms The Chainbridge Suite Our luxury suite with a gigantic private balcony, king-size bed, separate lounge & bespoke whirlpool bathroom.
